discoveryRule: Only the 47 observed catalog IDs and explicitly named variationComboIds returned by their public family endpoints. No guessed or enumerated IDs.
authentication: None. No cookies, tokens or API keys.
descriptionPolicy: Creative productDesc text is not copied. Product descriptions are short summaries assembled from category, brand, indoor/outdoor and country-of-origin facts.
shaderDefaults: Only providedMaterialValues are source values. Unspecified shader settings use explicit local defaults. Each provided map repeat and rotation is preserved unchanged in material.mapTransforms. attenuationDistance maps to distance.
rotationPolicy: Source mapping.rotation is degrees, confirmed by the public source applyMaterialV2 helper calling MathUtils.degToRad on mapping.rotation. Raw degree values are preserved in mapTransforms and the legacy textureRotation degree UI. Of 445 source products, only SKU460 normalMapping.rotation=1 is nonzero.

rotationEvidence.repeatRule: Positive mapping.x and mapping.y are direct repeat factors; optional positive mapping.scale multiplies both.

variantColorPolicy: colorHex from the source family response where provided. Existing image-average fallback is retained only when the source provides no colorHex.
